title: WAC 192-905-020, When is an employee entitled to a refund of premiums?

passages.question: Does HANGS owe either exempt employee a refund of WA Cares premiums?
passages.excerpt: (2) Any premium deductions made before notification was provided to the employer remain with the employer.
